title: SiteUpload
description: Per-site packet for aggregated OOD VIMP. Vectors are conditional-association scores on feature indices, not causal effects and not a site's share of a fleet effect. vimp_cov and vimp_con stay separate; they are never collapsed into one scalar.

vimp_cov.description: Simplex average of MMD-LOCO, HSIC-LOCO, and domain-classifier permutation VIMP.

vimp_con.description: Simplex average of PO-risk LOCO, R-risk LOCO, and DR-split VIMP.

D_k.description: Site dominance score in [-1, 1]. Positive leans concept, negative leans covariate. Not a share of the fleet.

feature_mask.description: True where this site observes the feature. Indices only; names are not uploaded.

diagnostics.description: Optional server-side echoes. Not required to pool the core packet.
